# Purpose

This file installs and loads packages for four common data sources:
1. Built-in and external datasets
2. PostgreSQL databases
3. APIs
4. Random or simulated datasets

Run the setup chunk first. You only need to install a package once on your computer.

# 1. Packages for datasets

```{r dataset-packages}
# Install packages for reading common data files
dataset_packages <- c("readr", "readxl", "haven", "dplyr")

# Install only packages that are not already installed
missing_packages <- dataset_packages[!dataset_packages %in% rownames(installed.packages())]
if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  install.packages(missing_packages)
}

# Load the packages
invisible(lapply(dataset_packages, library, character.only = TRUE))
```

```{r dataset-example}
# Use a dataset that comes with R
data("iris")

# Check the first rows
head(iris)
```

# 2. Packages for PostgreSQL

```{r postgres-packages}
# Install packages used to connect R to PostgreSQL
postgres_packages <- c("DBI", "RPostgres")

missing_packages <- postgres_packages[!postgres_packages %in% rownames(installed.packages())]
if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  install.packages(missing_packages)
}

invisible(lapply(postgres_packages, library, character.only = TRUE))
```

```{r postgres-example, eval=FALSE}
# Replace these example values with your database details
connection <- dbConnect(
  RPostgres::Postgres(),
  dbname = "school",
  host = "localhost",
  port = 5432,
  user = "postgres",
  password = "pass"
)

# See the tables in the database
dbListTables(connection)

# Close the connection when finished
dbDisconnect(connection)
```

# 3. Packages for APIs

```{r api-packages}
# Install packages for sending web requests and reading JSON
api_packages <- c("httr2", "jsonlite")

missing_packages <- api_packages[!api_packages %in% rownames(installed.packages())]
if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  install.packages(missing_packages)
}

invisible(lapply(api_packages, library, character.only = TRUE))
```

```{r api-example, eval=FALSE}
# Example public API endpoint; run when you have internet access
response <- httr2::request("https://api.github.com") |>
  httr2::req_perform()

# Convert the response into text
api_text <- httr2::resp_body_string(response)

# Read the JSON response
api_data <- jsonlite::fromJSON(api_text)
api_data
```

# 4. Packages for random or simulated data

```{r random-packages}
# Install packages for generating random names and sample data
random_packages <- c("randomNames", "wakefield")

missing_packages <- random_packages[!random_packages %in% rownames(installed.packages())]
if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  install.packages(missing_packages)
}

invisible(lapply(random_packages, library, character.only = TRUE))
```

```{r random-example}
# Create a small random dataset using base R
set.seed(2026)

random_students <- data.frame(
  student_id = 1:10,
  age = sample(18:30, 10, replace = TRUE),
  score = sample(40:100, 10, replace = TRUE)
)

random_students
```

# Quick package summary

| Source | Packages | Main use |
|---|---|---|
| Datasets and files | `readr`, `readxl`, `haven`, `dplyr` | Read and manage data |
| PostgreSQL | `DBI`, `RPostgres` | Connect to PostgreSQL |
| APIs | `httr2`, `jsonlite` | Request and read API data |
| Random data | `randomNames`, `wakefield` | Generate sample data |

**Reminder:** PostgreSQL and API examples are not run automatically. Add your own database details or API endpoint before running them.
